item.title: Rajasthan’s Viral ‘Mini Switzerland’ Flocked by Tourists Is a Marble Dump Yard - Doctors Warn of Severe Lung Damage
item.description: Rajasthan’s viral “Mini Switzerland” in Kishangarh is actually a marble slurry dump, doctors warn, posing serious lung risks. Fine dust particles can cause respiratory issues and even silicosis with prolonged exposure. Tourists unknowingly inhale harmful particles while visiting. Experts advise avoiding such sites and taking precautions to protect lung health from irreversible damage.
